# SecMesh-PQSI

> Clean-room Post-Quantum (PQ) and Post-Super-Intelligence (PSI = information-theoretic) cryptographic mesh defense engine (`v2.1.0`) rebuilt atop Tsotchke's stack, backed by 27 zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 theorems verified across all 6 distinct proof kernels via `lake comparator --paranoid` and two companion AMS-LaTeX white papers.

## Core Entrypoints
- [README.md](README.md): Overview, verbatim `#print axioms` 5-second proof, quickstart, and honest scope.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Canonical engineering and verification instructions.
- [CLAIMS.md](CLAIMS.md): Numbered claims ledger (`kernel-checked` / `differential-tested` / `numerical` / `open-problem`).
- [LIMITATIONS.md](LIMITATIONS.md): Explicit cryptographic, formalization, simulation, and tooling boundaries.
- [REPLICATION.md](REPLICATION.md): End-to-end clean-room replication steps.
